---CRITIQUE Tax-Claim-Covered Profitability---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: It replicates the structure of the already-successful "Cash-Covered Operating Profit" with a much narrower and lumpier denominator, and che/(che+txp) saturates near 1 for the large fraction of firms with negligible taxes payable, so the second leg will be near-degenerate noise rather than a real tax-settlement-capacity measure.
